entry.title: Creativity is a team sport | Walter Isaacson & Kent Walker

media:group.media:title: Creativity is a team sport | Walter Isaacson & Kent Walker
media:group.media:description:
Is innovation a solo pursuit? In this episode of Dialogues, bestselling author Walter Isaacson joins Kent Walker, Alphabet and Google President of Global Affairs, to explore how history’s greatest breakthroughs depended on collaboration, shared curiosity, and storytelling, and what that means for the AI era of today.
Together, they discuss how teamwork across disciplines drives technological progress, the role of human creativity alongside new tools, and how thoughtful innovation can shape technology for the benefit of society.
Chapters: 00:00 - Introductions 00:41 - The 50 year cycle of innovation 01:46 - Creativity is a team sport 02:27 - The Ada Lovelace school of thought 03:35 - Standing at the intersection of the humanities and technology 04:49 - Using Gemini Notebook for writing 05:22 - The J curve impact of AI tools 08:17 - What human agency can bring to AI
Explore More: Watch the full Dialogues series: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL590L5WQmH8f8ID51T0_9JkWpeL9Dcb-S
About Dialogues: Dialogues is a series that connects global leaders, thinkers, and historians to discuss the ideas shaping technology, culture, and society.
About The Guests: Walter Isaacson: Bestselling author, historian, and professor of history at Tulane University. Kent Walker: President of Global Affairs at Alphabet and Google.

entry.title: 3 Google Search study hacks for students 📚

media:group.media:title: 3 Google Search study hacks for students 📚
media:group.media:description:
Here are 3 ways to use Google Search to help with your next study session:
📄 Turn your notes into PDFs 1️⃣ Head to AI Mode and tap the ➕ button 2️⃣ Select “Add files” to upload your notes 3️⃣ Search “turn my notes into a pdf”
📝 Make a practice quiz from your notes 1️⃣ Open AI Mode and tap the ➕ button 2️⃣ Select “Add files” to upload your study materials 3️⃣ Search “make a quiz using my notes”
🌌 Create interactive visuals 1️⃣ Go to AI Mode 2️⃣ Search “create an interactive visual of [topic]” 3️⃣ Adjust the sliders to see complex concepts come to life
#StudyHacks #GoogleSearch #Exams

entry.title: What’s New in Google Accessibility | Episode 13 | American Sign Language

media:group.media:title: What’s New in Google Accessibility | Episode 13 | American Sign Language
media:group.media:description:
Welcome back to another episode of What's New in a Accessibility at Google at Google, a series where we share the latest product and feature updates that help make Google more accessible for everyone.
In this episode, we explore exciting new features designed to assist and empower our users: - Pixel & Android: Discover new tools including Rambler, Sign-to-Text, Motion Assist, and updates to Voice Access, along with Guided Frame powered by Gemini. - Gemini: Learn about Guided Vision to assist with navigating your surroundings. - Chrome & Workspace: Check out the latest updates to Reading Mode and our new Neurodiversity Guide. - Search & Gboard: Explore AI Mode Keyboard Navigation and the new Scalable Emojis. - Plus, we are thrilled to announce the launch of our new accessibility website and the Accessibility Help Community!
To watch this video without American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation, please click here: https://youtu.be/lL7L6DiGeLc
To sign up for our accessibility newsletter and for more information, visit: https://accessibility.google/
